response.original_title: Nao 上帝赐予的奇迹· 神宮寺ナオ
response.overview: The star of this production is Nao Jinguji! She is a stunning beauty—elegant in both demeanor and appearance, with flowing, graceful hair. This project, featuring both a video shoot and a photo book, takes place on the island of Amami Oshima—a true paradise rich in natural splendor. You can sense Nao’s palpable excitement and slight nervousness upon her first arrival on the island, followed by a series of expressive, radiant moments captured amidst the mild, pleasant climate. Nao herself even contributed ideas for the outfits and hairstyles, ensuring a diverse and dynamic range of looks. We invite you to enjoy this collection—a stylish photo book and video—that perfectly showcases her natural, mature charm. A mysterious beauty shining in the southern sun—a true miracle gifted by the heavens!
response.tagline: Mysterious beauty × extremely provocative × no mosaic.
response.title: Nao: A Miracle Gifted by God
